section_summary: Pages 401–453 contain short profiles of Japanese machine tool manufacturers, recording products, plant locations, and occasional founding dates. Pages 454–470 introduce and profile companies considered doubtful because they appeared in prisoner of war interrogation reports but not Japanese directories. Pages 471–480 begin a further list of doubtful manufacturers, with locations and products, drawn from a factory directory.

subfiles.title: Additional Doubtful Machine Tool Manufacturers
subfiles.about: Directory list of manufacturers classed as doubtful, with plant locations and products.
subfiles.summary: The list begins with Adachi Kikai Seisakusho and continues alphabetically through Hiraoka Tekkosho. It identifies factories across Japan and their reported products, chiefly lathes, grinders, presses, drills, milling machines, and other machine tools. Several firms have multiple plant locations; the list continues beyond page 480.
